title: Advantage Grand Canyon Adventure Rafting Trips and Tours
specs: Trips cover full Grand Canyon or sections: Upper, Lower, Western Canyon
Western Canyon offers warm water, moderate rapids, no hiking, and easy access
One-day trip includes helicopter exit and big rapids
Minimum age 8 years for 1-day whitewater trip, life jackets must fit properly
Life jackets required for children 12 and under on smooth water float trips
No previous rafting experience required for most trips
Bright Angel Trail hike is strenuous and only recommended for fit, motivated travelers
Western Canyon trips suitable for families, older adults, first-timers, mixed-age groups

services.name: One Day Guided Motorized Raft Trip

includes: Backhaul boat ride upriver for smooth water trips
Round-trip transportation from Page, AZ for smooth water trips
Bus transportation from Hualapai Lodge to river for 1-day whitewater trip
Lunch including deli sandwiches, snacks, water, and soft drinks on 1-day trip
Helicopter lift out of the canyon on 1-day whitewater trip
Life jackets and dry bags provided
blurb: Advantage Grand Canyon specializes exclusively in Grand Canyon rafting trips, offering expert guidance to match travelers with the best trip based on dates, budget, and preferences. Trips range from half-day smooth water floats to multi-day whitewater rafting adventures covering different sections of the canyon. They provide detailed information on trip types, durations, prices, and logistics, including shuttle and helicopter options.
